Fun and Games

Music

sdaw
Pretty good monochromatic digital audio workstation. Not mobile compatible
Klattsch
Primitive voice synthesizer. Browser version is already quite robust but full version can be bought on itch.io.
Thirty Dollar Website
Create music from memes.
Incredibox Demo
Dress-up beatboxing game.

Classic games

Classic Mahjong
Lichess
Solitaire Owl

Incremental

A Dark Room
Kindle a fire and launch a spaceship
Cookie Clicker
The original incremental. Bake cookies. Also on Steam, but the browser and Steam version are the exact same game.
Swarm Simulator
A minimalist game where you manage a swarm of bees
Universal Paperclips
Make paperclips. Not mobile compatible

Wordle-likes

Games that change their answer every day and end in "-le"

Globle
Guess a country and it'll show how far away your guess is from the mystery country.
Murdle
Solve a logic grid puzzle with a murder mystery flavor. Also: a daily cryptogram.
Semantle
Instead of trying to guess based on how far the letters are, you guess based on how far the meaning is. AKA by semantics.

Horror

Lomando.com
"Scary" Japanese site (there is also an English version). Lots of jumpscares and loud noises.
The Uncle who works for Nintendo
Text-based game where you stay over at your friends' house.

Roguelikes

Dungeons and Degenerate Gamblers
Extensive demo of the full game. Technically works on mobile, but I wouldn't recommend it.
Vampire Survivors
Extensive demo of the full game.
